name: HackerTube
author: Personal
description: Personal PipePipe plugin for hackertube.org with personalized feeds, labeled HN comments, topic areas, curated playlists, local history/playlist ranking, and offline snapshot fallback.

settings.title: HackerTube Base URL
settings.summary: Base URL of the HackerTube web service or mirror

settings.title: Open videos directly in YouTube
settings.summary: Emit native YouTube items instead of HackerTube pages (bypasses HN comments and summaries)

settings.title: Use neutral video frames
settings.summary: Prefer middle-video frames (hq2.jpg) over custom YouTube clickbait thumbnails

settings.title: Personalize from PipePipe history & playlists
settings.summary: Read local PipePipe watch history and configurable Likes/Dislikes playlists to rank Home recommendations

settings.title: Likes playlist names
settings.summary: Comma-separated PipePipe local playlist names treated as liked videos for feed recommendations

settings.title: Dislikes playlist names
settings.summary: Comma-separated PipePipe local playlist names treated as disliked videos to steer feed away

settings.title: Hide watched videos in Home
settings.summary: Exclude videos already in PipePipe watch history from the Home feed

settings.title: Force local snapshot mode
settings.summary: Serve Home, Browse, Search, and HN comments locally from cached hackertube-data.zip without server calls

settings.title: Hide news items in feeds
settings.summary: Filter out ephemeral shelf_life=news videos in Home and Browse lists (still searchable)

settings.title: Hide unrecommended citations in Home
settings.summary: Only show videos with at least one HN recommendation (hn.recommenders > 0) in Home

settings.title: Snapshot refresh interval (hours)
settings.summary: How often to refresh hackertube-data.zip and playlists locally for offline/sunset fallback (0 disables)
